title: TE Russell D. Toms and TE William L. Thompson v. Central Florida Presbytery
disposition_detail: Specification of error sustained (9–4): Central Florida Presbytery should not have received TE Abraham Castor while a call to labor in another presbytery was pending, under BCO 13-2,5. The entire matter was remanded/referred back to Central Florida Presbytery (13–0) for proper procedures regarding his admission to the PCA.
first_summary: Central Florida Presbytery admitted TE Abe Castor without a call within its bounds even though he had a call to labor in a neighboring presbytery. The Judicial Commission denied the complaint but sustained a specification of error and referred the matter back to presbytery for proper admission procedures under BCO 13-2,5.
summary: Central Florida Presbytery received a minister while he had a pending call to labor in another presbytery. A Judicial Commission sustained the specification of error, holding that BCO 13-2,5 barred receiving him under those circumstances; the vote was 9–4. It also voted 13–0 to remand the entire matter for proper procedures regarding his admission to the PCA. The Commission commended the presbytery's aim of receiving him but ruled the process erroneous, leaving the admission to be handled through proper procedures.
